studies.title: Integration of GWAS and single-cell analysis for psoriasis identifies disease-associated cell subtypes and therapeutic targets
studies.claim: The paper reports 125 independent psoriasis susceptibility loci, including 17 novel loci.
studies.summary: The Helix card tested 105 of 122 available loci. 101 of 105 effects matched the published direction; 53 passed the corrected threshold, compared with 103.8 expected at the published effects.
secondarySignals: Of 14 tested novel loci, 12 matched direction and 4 met the replication threshold.
The effect-size slope was 0.49, indicating smaller estimates than the published results.
studies.caveat: The card notes that three conditional signals could not be reconstructed without the paper's summary statistics. It also notes that the verdict rule was set after results were seen.

studies.title: Discovering Age- and Sex-Specific Genetic Risk Factors in Sensorineural Hearing Loss: Genome-Wide Evidence from Large-Scale Biobanks
studies.journal: Journal of the Association for Research in Otolaryngology
studies.claim: The paper reports nine novel sensorineural hearing-loss loci across overall, sex-specific, and age-of-onset analyses.
studies.summary: Eight of nine reported variants were testable. Seven of eight effects matched direction; one passed the corrected threshold, compared with 7.8 expected at the published effects.
secondarySignals: Seven of eight estimates were in the published direction (88%).
The effect-size slope was 0.24, so estimates were substantially smaller than published.
studies.caveat: The report says its verdict is pending and the verdict rule was set after results were seen.

studies.title: Genetic evidence supports the combined targeting of lipoprotein(a) and LDL cholesterol to reduce coronary artery disease risk
studies.claim: The paper reports lower coronary disease odds among LPA and PCSK9 loss-of-function carriers, with the lowest odds among carriers of both genes.
studies.summary: The combined-carrier primary result did not reproduce: OR 1.01 (p=0.914) versus OR 0.73 in the paper. Two single-gene comparisons were significant in the expected direction.
studies.powerBasis: 83% power for the combined primary claim
studies.primaryFinding: Combined LPA and PCSK9 carriers: OR 1.01 (95% CI 0.84-1.21), p=0.914; paper OR 0.73.
secondarySignals: LPA pLoF carriers: OR 0.94, p=4.1e-4; replicated against paper OR 0.91.
PCSK9 pLoF plus p.Arg46Leu: OR 0.89, p=2.3e-5; replicated against paper OR 0.81.
PCSK9 pLoF only: OR 0.79, p=0.114; not significant against paper OR 0.59.
studies.caveat: The report uses a 0.025 significance threshold for the two-gene analysis and says its verdict rule was set after results were seen.

studies.title: Genetic drivers of etiologic heterogeneity in thyroid cancer
studies.claim: The paper reports common variants at 51 loci associated with thyroid-cancer risk across ancestries, including 21 novel loci.
studies.summary: The Helix card tested 48 of 51 loci. 47 of 48 effects matched direction; 27 passed the corrected threshold, compared with 37.9 expected at the published effects.
secondarySignals: Of 19 tested novel loci, all 19 matched direction and 6 met the replication threshold.
All five strongest loci listed in the report replicated in the expected direction.
studies.caveat: The effect-size slope was 0.83. The card notes that its verdict rule was set after results were seen.

studies.title: Exome sequencing points to pathogenic ATM variants in gastric cancer
studies.claim: The paper reports enrichment of rare pathogenic loss-of-function variants in ATM among gastric-cancer cases; CDH1 is a secondary established-gene result.
studies.summary: The primary ATM finding was not significant in the Helix cohort: OR 1.85 (p=0.411) versus paper OR 3.94. The secondary CDH1 result was significant, while FANCA had too few carriers to estimate.
studies.powerBasis: 72% power for the ATM primary claim
studies.primaryFinding: ATM pLoF carriers: OR 1.85 (95% CI 0.51-6.65), p=0.411; paper OR 3.94.
secondarySignals: CDH1 pLoF carriers: OR 83.5 (95% CI 10.7-653), p=2.5e-5; paper OR 11.2.
FANCA had too few carriers to estimate.
studies.caveat: The CDH1 estimate is based on sparse carriers and has a wide confidence interval. Carrier counts below five are suppressed in the report.
